snippet.title: Wednesdays - Acessibility Trailer - Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: "The hardest part is not to speak up. It’s being heard." Part video game, part graphic novel, Wednesdays seeks to raise awareness about child sexual abuse through a surprisingly hope-filled story.
